description.value:
While the creature marked by your Ranger's Quarry is within 15 feet of you, it suffers the following:

  • Whenever it casts a force power, it must first succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your tech save DC to maintain concentration; on a failure, the casting is disrupted, the power fails, and its force points are wasted.
  • Whenever it starts its turn concentrating on a force power, it must make that same Constitution save or lose concentration.

This feature's radius grows to 30 feet at 11th level and 60 feet at 17th level.
